entries.developer_comments: ~ Description of mutation 'Strike the Inner Outsider'
identity: The People is meant to fight the things from Outside, but sometimes they must fight what is inside their own bodies.  You can focus your mana to try and cure most ailments caused by beings from the Nether, from Under the Hill and from wherever vampires come from.  The amount of mana this requires increases with the amount and severity of your afflictions, and will fail if your mana is insufficient.

that people share, or something they can film by themselves.
identity:
This appears to be a segment of bodycam footage, with the perspective shaking as the wearer jogs through a dimly lit corridor, a drawn pistol's muzzle leading the way.  Rounding a bend, any forward progress is promptly arrested as a formally dressed woman comes into the shot.  Hefting a large sledgehammer and crushing the skulls of zombie after zombie clambering through a shattered window, an expression of childish glee is plastered across her face.

Glancing towards the camera, her maniacal grin grows wider as she abandons her post and, stumbling on high heels, rushes towards the view.  Heedless of the bullets that plunge into her gore-caked body, the enraptured look upon the woman's face as she swings the mallet and blood spurts across the lens is going to haunt you in your sleep.

identity: A deeply disturbing ooze that seems to attempt to take on form over and over again, never quite succeeding.  The only thing it seems to manage are eyes that look around madly for a few seconds before dissolving back into the steaming gunk.
